Local modifications:
  gamecontrollerdb.txt is byte-for-byte upstream. The license wording is
  unchanged; trailing spaces on three lines and one empty line after the final
  notice were removed so repository text files pass whitespace validation and
  end with one newline. This provenance record and build/package integration
  are VOX additions.

Distribution:
  The database is copied into share/digs/controllers/gamecontrollerdb.txt
  for SDL2 to load before controller enumeration. The license is reproduced
  in LICENSES/SDL_GameControllerDB.txt in binary bundles. Corresponding Source
  archives retain this complete vendored directory.

Update procedure:
  Pin a reviewed upstream commit, replace both upstream files without local
  edits, recompute SHA-256 and Git blob identities, update this record plus
  THIRD_PARTY.md and the package integrity assertion, and repeat controller
  mapping and license/SBOM acceptance checks.
